svg.title: Witt's theory: chromogen = benzene ring + chromophore; dye = chromogen + auxochrome
svg.desc: Witt's theory shown on benzene, azobenzene, aniline yellow and methyl orange with chromophore and auxochrome highlighted
svg.text: Witt's theory: chromogen = benzene ring + chromophore; dye = chromogen + auxochrome
Red = chromophore (colour-bearer) · Green = auxochrome (colour-intensifier / fibre-affinity group)
Chromophore (–N=N–) gives colour; auxochrome (–NH₂, –NMe₂, –OH) deepens it and lets the molecule bind the fibre.
Sulphonate (–SO₃Na) is a solubilising group; it also acts as an acidic auxochrome.
